inherited.M01: Training data come from the same prompted overt or covert word-repetition runs that are tested; no separate training-time action.
inherited.M02: No training-only signal: labels are the displayed word's vowel or consonant pair; the microphone is not used as a target.
inherited.M05: Clinical subdural grids (48 or 64 contacts, 1 cm spacing) recorded with BCI2000 and g.USBamp, the Leuthardt/Schalk ECoG lineage.
inherited.M07: No language model or lexicon; closed-set four-class classification.
inherited.M09: Offline study: no presentation or confirmation step.
inherited.M13: Bedside epilepsy-monitoring recordings, offline analysis, no released analysis code.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger text names decoding, classification or recognition together with imagined, covert, inner or unspoken speech (any signal: EEG, MEG, ECoG, sEEG, intracortical, EMG, video). The design of interest is a decoder trained and tested on imagined-speech trials, with an overt condition on the same items in the same participants, from intracranial recordings. Boundary: attempted speech by paralysed users is a different action and is not counted as imagined speech; the ledger pattern also admits lip-reading and perception studies that mention covert speech, so counts are upper bounds; versions of one study count once; usual approach judged on studies first public before 2011.
topics.metric: Imagined-speech decoding accuracy against chance, with the overt condition in the same participants.

topics.inclusion_rule: Studies whose ledger text names an intracranial signal (ECoG, sEEG, intracortical, Utah array) together with phonemes, vowels, consonants or syllables; the design of interest is whether speech units are decoded from each electrode separately (with the best location reported) or from several electrodes jointly. Boundary: listening-only and review papers matched by the pattern stay in the count (upper bound); word-level intracranial decoders are outside the pattern and are used only as read priors; versions of one study count once; usual approach judged on studies first public before 2011.
topics.metric: Speech-unit classification accuracy against chance; electrode use.

topics.inclusion_rule: Published rule kept: intracranial speech or language decoding studies; the design of interest is how test data are separated from training data (random trial split, k-fold cross-validation, held-out session or day, held-out subject). This review adds a prior-time tally (first public before 2011) under prior_tally_<slug>.

notes: M03 (selection nesting, normalization, folds) and M11 (prompt-defined covert labels) are judged from the target's own text without an audit; their table counts are null.
